info.name: Dopamine API
info.description:
Dopamine is a social app for connecting people: share posts, follow friends (private accounts approve followers), comment and react, get notified, and chat one-to-one or in groups in real time.

Set `baseUrl`, run **Auth → Sign in**: the access/refresh tokens and created ids are stored in collection variables automatically.
OpenAPI docs: {{baseUrl}}/docs

item.name: Auth
item.description: Register, verify email, sign in (password or Google), refresh and revoke sessions, reset passwords.

request.description: Emails a 6-digit code; verify it with `POST /auth/verify-otp` before signing in. Rate limited (10 failed / 15 min).

item.name: Verify email with the emailed code

request.description: Rate limited (10 / 15 min, shared with the other code endpoints).

item.name: Sign in with email and password

request.description: Returns an access + refresh token pair. Rate limited (10 failed / 15 min).

exec: const body = pm.response.json();
try { const v = body.data.access_token; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', v); } catch (e) {}
try { const v = body.data.refresh_token; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Single use: the refresh token is revoked and a new pair is returned. Rate limited (30 / 15 min).

exec: const body = pm.response.json();
try { const v = body.data.access_token; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', v); } catch (e) {}
try { const v = body.data.refresh_token; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: `type: "SINGLE"` (default) revokes this session (+ the given refresh token); `"ALL"` revokes every session.

item.name: Follow requests
item.description: Following public accounts is instant; private accounts receive a request to accept or reject.

exec: const body = pm.response.json();
try { const v = body.data[0]._id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('requestId', v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Public accounts are followed at once (`status: "following"`); private ones get a request (`status: "requested"`).

item.description: Activity about you (follows, likes, comments, shares). Also pushed live as `notification:new`.

request.description: `meta.unreadCount` carries the unread total. Add `unread=true` for unread only.
